description: Verbatim copies of the VoxConvo editing code that the editing fixtures are generated from. Same author as VoxClip; vendored unmodified so the fixtures can be regenerated without a VoxConvo checkout. The loader refuses to run if a file's sha1 does not match.
copiedFrom: VoxConvo working tree, vox-web on top of commit 221a5dc840405df3d1af9d5219b2d137d1f44710 (2025-11-12) with uncommitted edits, copied 2026-10-25
publicationApproval: pending: the repository owner confirms publishing these files before the first push (doc/plan.md, open questions). Without approval, delete the .ts files; the generator then needs VOXCONVO_WEB_DIR.

files.note: Byte-identical to vox-api/src/utils/mediaTimeline.ts. Edit plan, cut ranges, time mapping, caption copy.
clipTimes. The import of ./videoJob is replaced by a constant at load time; the network helpers are never called.
